answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after locking a scarce stake for a fixed period and completing tasks whose results are checked against independent evidence; duplicate identities do not multiply that weight. A challenge bond lets anyone contest suspicious work, with the bond paid to the verifier if the claim fails and the agent’s stake slashed if it succeeds. A hollow profile may look saffron-bright and carry a quill, but each fake still needs capital, time, and verifiable work, while detection risks forfeiting the stake.
